name: Dashy v4
description: Dashy helps you organize your self-hosted services by making them accessible from a single place

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the dashy-v4 application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-dashy-v4
  big-bear-dashy-v4:
    # Image to be used for the app service
    image: lissy93/dashy:4.0.8@sha256:1b3de6159d93e1a75f0b808e74d8cb5100c06251b120abd2d68e557ec7544ab6
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-dashy-v4
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/user-data:/app/user-data
    # Ports mapping
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    # Set any environmental variables
    environment:
      - NODE_ENV=production
    # Restart policy for the container
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Configure healthchecks for the service
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "node", "/app/services/healthcheck.js"]
      interval: 1m30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 40s
